qualification.details: Qualification: M.E./ MCA/ M.Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science/ Electrical Engineering/ Electronics/ Information Technology, or M.Sc. in Statistics/ Applied Statistics and Analytics/ Mathematics/Physics/ Electronics/Computer Science; Knowledge of Design and Analysis of Algorithms; Knowledge of Graph Algorithms; All through First Class Age limit: Maximum 35 years (as on the date of the walk-in-interview) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Women Usual relaxation, Outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience Age relaxation may be given | Other conditions: | All through First Class Knowledge of Design and Analysis of Algorithms Knowledge of Graph Algorithms | Desirable: | Knowledge of Computational Social Choice/Parameterized Algorithms Knowledge of writing proof of correctness of algorithms

how_to_apply: Bring an application addressed to the Professor-In-Charge, Computer and Communication Sciences Division, ISI, 203 B. T. Road, Kolkata 700108 to the interview on 19-11-2026 at 11:30 am.
Include preference(s) of project(s) and a signed current resume (CV) in English with the details the notice lists.
Bring original and self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials.
For the online interview, email the signed application and CV with scanned copies of all original documents to [email protected] (CC to [email protected]) by 15-11-2026.
Eligible online candidates will receive the interview link by email.
important_instructions: No TA/DA for attending the interview or joining the post Institute has no residential facilities for contractual staff Medical certificate of fitness from the Institute's Medical Officer and documents verification at joining; failing these, the post goes to the next candidate in the merit list Institute reserves the right not to appoint any of the above Queries to [email protected] (CC to [email protected]) by 15-11-2026

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 19 November 2026, and candidates report at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Project Linked Junior Research Fellow.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ISI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 19 November 2026 at 11:30 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 35 years (as on the date of the walk-in-interview). Relaxation: SC/ST/OBC-NCL/PwBD/Women Usual relaxation, Outstanding candidates or candidates with relevant experience Age relaxation may be given.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Consolidated Rs. 37,000 per month plus 30% HRA = Rs. 48,100 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: M.E./MCA/M.Tech. or equivalent degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering/Electronics/Information Technology, or M.Sc. in Statistics/Applied Statistics and Analytics/Mathematics/Physics/Electronics/Computer Science; knowledge of Design and Analysis of Algorithms and of Graph Algorithms; all through First Class.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. All through First Class. Knowledge of Design and Analysis of Algorithms. Knowledge of Graph Algorithms.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: CV with incomplete information or without supporting documents (original and self-attested) will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview of shortlisted candidates. Selection of shortlisted candidates through an interview. Interview may be attended in person or online; online candidates get the link by email.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely temporary and contractual appointment. Initially till 31 March 2027; may be extended (up to 3 years) later or terminated earlier depending on funds and performance. No right to claim permanent employment under ISI Kolkata or continuation in other projects.
